summary: Current raw OPFS composite AbortSignal remains packaged head; linked rev0192 closes a postured-factory contract hole by rejecting explicit writeBudgetGuard overrides before OPFS store creation, so an admitted posture receipt cannot silently disable the actual write-budget guard. Storage posture proof/audit and package boundary gates were updated without runtime promotion.
nonClaims: Postured guard override rejection is a local factory contract, not browser quota reservation.
Unsafe override opt-in remains caller-owned and does not imply eviction survival, fsync durability, or cross-tab quota reservation.
No persistent-storage grant, Storage Buckets support, Web Lock fairness, or cross-browser guarantee.
